# Maison Aurelia

> Luxury wedding planners crafting end-to-end celebrations across India and beyond — design, décor, photography, catering, venues and entertainment.

Maison Aurelia is a full-service luxury wedding planning house. We produce intimate ceremonies and multi-day destination celebrations, handling every detail from creative direction to on-the-day coordination.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, services, gallery preview and testimonials.
- [About](/about): Our story, team, process and philosophy.
- [Services](/services): Planning, décor, photography, catering, venues, entertainment and pricing packages.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Filterable portfolio of past weddings — decoration, reception, couple shoots, catering.
- [Contact](/contact): Enquiry form, studio location, contact details and FAQs.
